⭐ 1 Star – Disappointed With My Dog’s Grooming Experience

Unfortunately, I was very disappointed with my dog’s grooming experience. I explained that I wanted a #5 cut on her body, but specifically asked to keep her ears fluffy, clean up her paws, and trim only about half of the original length of the hair on top of her head.
When I picked her up, I was surprised by how short her hair had been cut, especially in the areas where I had specifically asked to keep more length. Her ears lost much of their beautiful fluffiness, and her head was cut shorter than I requested.
What disappointed me even more was the lack of attention to detail around her paws. I specifically asked for clean paws, but there was still uneven hair around her toes and between her paw pads.
I understand that grooming takes time and skill, and I respect the work groomers do. However, I believe it’s important to listen carefully to a customer’s requests, especially when specific instructions are given.
I wasn’t expecting perfection, just a haircut that reflected what I had asked for. Unfortunately, that wasn’t my experience, and I’m truly disappointed with the results.
I’ll be including some before-and-after pictures of my dog to see the difference between how she looked before her appointment and the results of her grooming.
